{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999999.99'
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders (by revenue): {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'

# Find QA orders that are completed
df_completed = df[completed_mask]
qa_in_completed = df_completed[qa_mask]
print(f'QA orders in completed: {len(qa_in_completed)}')

# Remove all QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~qa_mask]
df_clean_completed = df_clean[completed_mask]

# Check that no QA orders remain
assert len(df_clean_completed[df_clean_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']) == 0

# Now compute conversion rates by channel, within each customer_segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = pd.crosstab(
    df_clean_completed['channel'], 
    df_clean_completed['customer_segment'], 
    values=df_clean_completed['converted'], 
    aggfunc='mean'
)

print('\nConversion rates by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel (unadjusted)
overall_conv_by_channel = df_clean_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nOverall conversion rates (unadjusted):')
print(overall_conv_by_channel)

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = overall_conv_by_channel['email'] - overall_conv_by_channel['paid_search']
print(f'\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {difference}')"}
